title: Knowledge: report layouts and dataset contract, query join and grouping defaults
summary: Five knowledge articles were added to cover report layout declaration, report dataset column contracts, and query defaults for joins and grouping that differ from SQL conventions.
key_points: New reports should declare layouts in the rendering section instead of the legacy DefaultLayout, RDLCLayout, WordLayout and ExcelLayout properties, which are set to be deprecated
Report dataset column names are a contract with Excel Data sheets, Word XML parts and user-defined layouts, so renaming or removing them breaks those layouts
A layout added in a reportextension does not replace the base layout automatically; DefaultRenderingLayout cannot be set there and the layout must be selected
Query dataitems default to LeftOuterJoin when SqlJoinType is omitted, and every non-aggregated column becomes a group key
The al-reporting-review and al-query-review skills and the review fixtures were updated to use the new articles
quote: Report layout declaration and the report dataset/layout contract had only incidental mentions.
